QuestInfo.name: [Missing Santa] Torr's Whereabouts
QuestInfo.0: You took the picture as Cliff had requested, but Torr was not there! Cliff began to worry greatly about Torr. Let's listen to his unfinished story.
QuestInfo.1: Cliff asked you to check if the reindeer crying around the corner of Happyville is Torr. And if it is, he asked you to #btell Torr#k that he will be waiting on the 2nd floor at the Center Tower of Happyville.
QuestInfo.2: You've sent Torr back to lonely old man Cliff. It will be a warm and happy holiday, at least for those two.

0.0: Some people told me that they have seen a Rudolph crying around the corner of Happyville. I am worried that the one people are talking about might be #bTorr#k. Since I am away from home, he won't be able to go inside the house... He should be freezing outside.
0.1: Anyhow, it will be faster than an oldman like me if you can look for him and see if it's really #bTorr#k that people are talking about. Can you do it for me, you young handsome, pretty, kind Mapler? If it's #bTorr#k, please tell him to come to me. I will be waiting for him on the 2nd floor of center tower.

yes.0: I have a feeling that it is #bTorr#k. I shouldn't be relaxing like this if it really is Torr. I have to prepare to greet him. Please go find if Torr is the one they are talking about. And if so, deliver my words to him. Hurry... Thank you...

no.0: It shouldn't be that hard for you... Well if you say you are busy... Okay... But I recommend you to come find me again before you leave this town.

1.0: Sobs.. Sobs... T.T\nYou are not from this town right? You are the first one to talk to me today... Sobs... Sobs... I can't believe that people in this town has no interest in me what so ever just because I had to quit the Santa's Sledge club as I was not qualified. This is just too much for me to handle.
1.1: Sobs.... T.T\nI wasn't expecting a big welcome from the town people but I sure was expecting a warm welcome from #bGranpa Cliff#k... Now it seems like even he is out of town! What shall I do...? Where shall I go...?

yes.0: You mean Granpa Cliff??? He will be waiting for me on the 2nd floor of Center tower? How did he get up there anyway with his weak strength? I knew that he couldn't live without me! I should have never left the town...
yes.1: Thanks for letting me know where Cliff is! The thought of spending Christmas alone was so horrible that I was going to leave Happyville forever and become a monster outside of El Nath. I'm gonna go to Cliff and give him a big hug now... Merry Christmas!

npc.0: Please go check if it is #bTorr#k or not... And if it is... please tell him what I said!.. Please hurry, poor baby is freezing out there.
